vol.name: Final Boss: Black, White, and Blood

title: Final Boss: Black, White, and Blood #1
desc: BLACK WHITE AND BLOOD REPRINT A year ago, Final Boss #1 blew the roof off the comic industry and instantly sold out. Tommy Brazen set a new standard for pure, adrenaline-fueled action. Now, the gory slugfest returns in a special reprint stripped down to what really matters: black, white, and BLOOD red!
